name: Card
import: import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter } from "@/components/ui/card"
description: A borderless content surface for grouping related information and actions.

Card.description: Root grouped surface. Polymorphic through Base UI useRender.

tone.description: Soft semantic tint for status-aware surfaces while preserving the card structure.

padding.description: Vertical padding on the root. Child parts own horizontal padding.

interactive.description: Marks an interactive rendered card so focus styling and cursor are applied.

render.description: Render as an anchor, button, or custom element while keeping kubkit styling.

className.description: Layout escape hatch only; do not add custom borders or raw colors.

children.description: Usually CardHeader, CardContent, and optional CardFooter.

CardHeader.description: Top area for title text and an optional action, laid out as a slot-aware two-column grid.

children.description: Wrap title/description in a small stack and place CardAction as the last child.

CardAction.description: Optional header action area pinned to the top-right of the header grid.

children.description: A compact kubkit Button, DropdownMenu trigger, or status badge.
Text, metrics, forms, lists, or custom content.

CardFooter.description: Optional action row pinned after content.

children.description: One primary action and supporting secondary actions.

forbidden: Do not use Card as a generic page section wrapper.
Do not nest cards inside cards.
Do not add custom visible borders to Card.
Do not make the entire Card interactive when only one child action is interactive.
Do not use tone as a substitute for Alert when the content is transient feedback or needs stronger urgency.
Do not use elevated cards in dense repeated lists.

responsive.note: Interactive cards and card actions must keep 44px touch targets. Repeated cards should remain compact on mobile.

Team activity Recent updates from the workspace.
